0.0: Hey, #b#h0##k... Since you're here, how about you help me out?
0.1: So it's like this... A few days ago, I was all worn out from, you know, standing around, so I took a nap in the park. I heard kids snickering, and they shouted, 'GO HOME, CYGNUS KNIGHT, GO HOME!' I thought it was a dream, but...
0.2: When I opened my eyes, I was COVERED IN BUGS! Uggggghhhhh! I hate anything with more than two legs! Yuck. I ran out of there like my hair was on fire.
0.3:
I was in such a panic that I left my stuff behind! Can you look for my things? I bet those dratted #bkids#k took them...
